featured_reviews.review_text:
Very weird and extremely disappointing experience. I ordered Singapore Chicken Fried Rice but it honestly felt like I had ordered sweet coconut rice instead. The rice was dry, had a strange sweet taste, and there was almost no chicken in it. The appearance of the food was also very odd. It only had a few onions and green capsicum pieces and even those looked strange and not fresh.

I had to eat it with difficulty because I did not have time to return it or raise a complaint at that moment.

This is not the first issue I have faced with this restaurant. The last time I ordered Paneer Fried Rice and tea, but the tea was missing from my order. When I called the restaurant, they told me they would add it in my next order if I reminded them. Obviously, no one places another order just to claim one tea that was already paid for.

I also tried for a long time to connect with Zomato support and even that experience was frustrating. After multiple attempts the call finally connected and I did receive my refund, but the overall experience was still very poor.

After a long time I decided to order again because this item was showing as highly reordered and recommended on the app. The price was ₹240 and I used a discount coupon to get it for a lower price. But using a discount coupon does NOT mean the restaurant can pack anything they want or compromise with food quality and quantity.

There was also no option for half or full portion, so I expected proper quantity and standard quality. The delivery itself took almost one hour, so clearly the food was not prepared in a hurry. That makes it even more shocking that such poor quality food was delivered.

I did not even click any pictures because the experience itself was enough to regret ordering.

During the Ramadan month people order food with trust, especially for iftar. Facing such poor quality food during this time is extremely disappointing and unacceptable.

Zomato seriously needs to take action against restaurants that send such poor quality food to customers. Platforms should not just show “highly recommended” or “most reordered” tags if the actual food quality is this bad. Customers trust these ratings and spend their money based on them.

Because of this experience I will avoid ordering from this restaurant again and I will not recommend it to anyone. Ratings might look good on the platform, but in reality the service and food quality felt worse than zero.

featured_reviews.review_text:
For the first time I had Bohri food , recommended by many I finally decided to give this place a try . I am absolutely in love with the bohri food here . The food being home cooked has it own taste and flavours .

The traditional way was followed from washing hands to having a pinch of salt at the end .

The Bohri thal consisit of :

1.       Lemon Cooler : The refresher drink was served . Quite decent love the pudina flavour in it .

2.       Lajawab Shammi Kebab : They are basically Mutton Kebabs , the kebab was perfectly cooked  and soft .

3.       Mazedaar Chicken Samosa :This was something I could resist . Firstly the cover was so crispy and the second chicken stuffing was delicious .

4.       Masti Mutton kheema Samosa : The mutton kheema samosa , the samosa was crispy and tasty . I had this for the first time and I liked it .

5.       Shandaar Mutton Haleem Bohri Khichda :  This is something interesting , the twist to the normal khichda , it is a full meal in itself because it has everything like mutton , dal and rice which traditional bohri masala as well .

6.       Bohri Khari chawal : This is again their traditional recipe which has normal rice with some caramelized onions and the khari is made with chicken and some traditional bohri masala .

7.       Nawaabi kheer : I found it similar to the phirini , but the best thing about it was not that sweet which made me more perfect with the meal .

8.       Pan : We eneded our meal with a meetha pan .

The food was super delicious and also tasty , being home cooked it was perfect . The food wasn’t cooked that spicy also made us feel light .

Definitely a must visit place if you love bohri food . Do give it a try .

We look forward to the pleasure of serving you again.

Warm regards,
Team Sams Bohri Zaika

featured_reviews.name: Ahmed Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered some food from Sam's Bohri Zaika for myself and a group of friends and we absolutely loved everything!
They have a wide range of bohri food options and the food is reasonably priced
We ordered:
Lajawab Shami Kebab: These shami kebabs were cooked so well that they would just melt in your mouth. The kebabs were coated with egg and the filling was a mixture of minced mutton and dal. Very unique dish, I highly recommend it!
Mutton Seekh Kebab: Mutton skewers marinated in a great spice mix, these go great with Pav.
Chicken Keema Samosa: Crispy Triangle Samosa filled with a yum Chicken Keema filling, a great starter!
Mutton Khichda (Haleem): A mixture of dals and crushed wheat, the mutton pieces are perfectly cooked. This dish is simply superb, and unlike anything I have had before.
Mutton Kaleji Gurda with Pav: Mutton liver and kidney cooked in a delicious bohri style gravy. Loved it!
Bohri Chicken Tikka Biryani: Perfectly spiced boneless chicken tikka with delicious biryani rice. The quantity of chicken was generous and the biryani is served with raita, this is a must try.
Nawaabi Kheer: A rich rice based kheer with dry fruits, the best way to end a home cooked meal!
I loved every single item we had and I am sure I will keep ordering from Sam's Bohri Zaika!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks so much Ahmed for your detailed review. We are open again so we look forward to your next order very soon

featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a pleasant experience visiting Sam’s Bohri Zaika and also trying out bohri food for the first time. Here you can find bohri food in its authentic way. It is a home based outlet run by Chef Samina and managed by their entire family. I must say they are wonderful hosts and highly proficient in cooking bohri food.

We were welcomed with lemon cooler indulged with pudina. We tried our hands on number of dishes like Chicken and Mutton Samosas, Mutton Haleem, Mutton Shammi Kebabs, Kaari Chawal and Kheer.

Out of all I would highly recommend Chicken Samosa and Mutton Haleem. The chicken stuffing in the samosa was just perfect with the cover being crisp and it was not oily at all. In Mutton Haleem-The succulent pieces of mutton wrapped in a perfect blend of barley, wheat, lentils and spices gives a paste like consistency which is a scrumptious result.

Happy Eating :)
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Pushpak, we know you are very selective in choosing the places where you eat. So thanks very much for trying us out and for your wonderful words. We truly appreciate it.

featured_reviews.name: Ajay Gaurav
featured_reviews.review_text:
The giant thaal was exactly how Bohri Community Serves Food At Social Gatherings. The Thaal Consisted of Mutton and Chicken Kheema (Patti) Samosa, Mutton Khichda, Shaami Kebab (Mutton), And Chicken Biryani, YES!!! And wait the list isn’t over, there was the trusty old vegetable raita, minty curd, and tamarind and raw onion chutney for the Khichda. We started of with “obviously” the Shaami kebabs and they were simply melt in the mouth. And went well with any of the accompaniments on the thaal.  The next on the list was smoked mutton keema samosa, and chicken keema samosa. And man they were so crispy and light, and the smokiness of the mutton keema was subtle yet identifiable, and elevated the meat and spices to a different level.
While I was busy devouring the kebabs and samosas, Abbas was kind enough warm up the Khichda and Biryani for us. Khichda was so intensely flavourful yet not at all spicy, and the mix of lentils and wheat and meat was just right.
The Biryani, well one word AMAZING! I could have eaten the whole bowl. But you need to act civilised sometimes 😉 . Mr. Abizar Shaikh, discussed how they made sure that the meat and all other ingredients were chosen and carefully sourced from the right vendors. And how important was it to maintain the taste and the quality of the end product. While the discussion went on and we managed to finish all the food on the plate, out came the desert it was extremely light rice kheer flavoured with rose and kewra essence and yet all notes were just perfectly balanced.

In the end there was another typical Bohri Handwash which Mr. Shaikh said was customary and while I thought my experience had come to a sweet end, there was another sweet surprise, out came the Indian mouth freshener  AKA PAAN this was sweet paan not like the enormous sweet paan you get at panwaadi but a lighter subtle version yet very refreshing. The entire Sam’s Bohri Zaika experience just raised the bar for me. I urge all of you who work in the Powai, Vikhroli, Mulund areas to look this place up and order away. I assure you are in for a wonderful treat. Please understand the Bohri Food is very different from the regular Mughlai or Irani Cuisine. It has a character of it’s own and I am sure you will fall in love with it once you have tasted it. A huge thanks to The Shaikh Family For Having Us Over and for the wonderful experience. Best Wishes @foodiefoot
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Ajay, always a pleasure to serve someone like you who appreciates the niceties of good cuisine and the way it's served. You rightly described Bohri dining as true community eating to be enjoyed with family and friends. And you can make more friends when dining together with new people! Thank you from all of us!

featured_reviews.name: Dubey Chandan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Utsav Cuisine, Powai – Simple, Satisfying, and Safe Choice

So I tried Utsav Cuisine in Powai and honestly, it’s one of those places that doesn’t scream for attention but quietly delivers a decent meal. Not too fancy, not too dramatic just simple Indian food done right.

The ambience is basic but clean. No flashy lights or trendy decor, just a calm and decent dining space where you can sit peacefully and eat without loud music or selfie-crazy crowds. It’s more of a family place than a hangout spot.

We ordered a few North Indian dishes – butter naan, paneer butter masala, dal tadka and jeera rice. The taste was good, nothing out-of-this-world, but definitely satisfying. The paneer was soft and the gravy was creamy. Dal had that homemade touch and the rice was well-cooked. So overall, you won’t be disappointed, but you also won’t be jumping out of your seat with excitement.

Service was fine. Not too fast, not too slow. Staff was polite, answered our questions, and didn’t hover too much.

Prices are reasonable for the quantity and quality. You get good value for a peaceful meal without burning your wallet.

So yeah, Utsav is not a place you’d choose for a celebration or a date night, but it’s definitely a safe pick for a casual lunch or dinner when you just want a good Indian meal without any drama. Average overall, but in a good way.

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited this restaurant yesterday as a group, and initially, the experience was quite good. The food was really delicious, and the ambiance had a calm and relaxing vibe, which we genuinely appreciated. We also noticed the “Atithi Devo Bhava” quote and admired the values it represents.

However, the experience took a disappointing turn toward the end.

We had spent less than an hour in the restaurant when we were asked to pay the bill quickly because billing was about to close. Immediately after making the payment, one of the staff members told us to leave, even though one of our group members was still eating.

This felt very disrespectful and rushed. Another server, who had been attending us from the beginning and was quite friendly while talking about their other branches like Mantra and Laxmi Pure Veg, just stood there smiling while this happened, which made it even more awkward.

The staff member even said, “Bar jaisa nahi hai ki late tak chalu rahega,” which was unnecessary and inappropriate. We were not there for drinks, and it is basic understanding that customers usually take at least 1 to 1.5 hours to finish their meals comfortably.

If the restaurant cannot accommodate customers for a reasonable dining duration, they should inform guests beforehand or stop accepting new customers at that time.

Being asked to leave immediately after paying, especially on our first visit, was extremely disappointing and left a bad impression.

If you truly believe in “Atithi Devo Bhava,” then please reflect that in how you treat your customers.

featured_reviews.name: Ashu Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Serious Food Safety Concern at Utsav Restaurant
My partner and I visited Utsav today and ordered chicken tikka and paneer tikka. Within just 10 minutes of eating the chicken tikka at the restaurant, I began experiencing severe stomach pain and was unable to finish my meal. For the next 4 hours, I suffered greatly, ultimately vomiting everything out.
The situation worsened when my partner, who had taken her order home, also fell severely ill around 2:30 AM and began vomiting as well.
We spent the entire night unwell and are still not feeling better.
I sincerely urge the Maharashtra Government Food Quality Inspectors to investigate this restaurant, particularly the quality and hygiene standards of their chicken and paneer tikka. No customer should have to go through this experience after dining out.

featured_reviews.review_text: Utsav Cuisine offers an amazing dining experience with delicious and flavorful dishes, where every item we tried was perfectly cooked and beautifully presented. featured_reviews.name: Chaitanya Jagtap
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience.

We visited Utsav Restaurant in Powai expecting to avail a 10–20% cashback offer through Zomato, which was one of the main reasons we chose this place. However, when it was time to pay, the staff outright refused to accept payment via Zomato without giving any proper explanation. This felt misleading and unprofessional.

To make matters worse, from entry to finishing most of our dinner, including wait time, we only spent around 50 minutes in total. Despite this, the staff rushed us to complete the payment, saying their billing was about to close even though one of us was still eating. Right after we paid, they asked us to leave while our meal wasn’t even fully finished.

This kind of behavior is unacceptable and completely ruined the dining experience. Poor service, lack of transparency, and no regard for customer comfort. Definitely not recommended.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for your feedback, Chaitanya.
We’d like to clarify that Utsav Cuisine is not a partner under Zomato Dining, and therefore cashbacks or bill payments via Zomato are not applicable at our restaurant. We operate only on a standard listing for visibility. Expecting platform-specific offers without confirming participation may lead to misunderstandings such as this.
Regarding your comments on service, our team did inform about billing closure timelines. However, we agree that this should have been communicated more politely and without making guests feel rushed. We will address this internally.
We stand by our commitment to provide a good dining experience and regret that this visit did not meet your expectations.
We truly value every guest who chooses to dine with us, and your feedback helps us improve both communication and service. We hope you will consider visiting us again for a better experience.
Warm Regards,
Team Utsav Cuisine.

You all know but like i said peco peco is just a tad bit different in its approach so it's medium spiced out and the quantity is also great along with it's gravy.

All in all i have loved it. Its been a great treat for me. Chilling on my couch with the world cup on with such great food is just the perfection i wanted. You all could try it out. Won't be disappointed . Adios.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Taftoon have finally opened their doors in powai. Dropped by this today for lunch and hands down it was a fab experience. I have been a huge fan of this brand since the time I visited their Bkc outlet and the fact they are near to my place I was excited trying their new outlet as well.
Talking about the ambience it was elegant and the bar here looks absolutely stunning. Taftoon has been known for its amazing interiors and very well thought decor overall and same we can witness in Powai outlet too.
Moving towards f&b part, in drinks we tried grapefruit and mint cooler & Cucumber and basil mocktails which were quiet refreshing and could be the best option to quench your thirst this summer. For the appetizers we had
1. Dahi bhutteyan de kebab : Fresh and melt in mouth texture having corn , green and yellow chillies and having perfect spice balance to it. It's a must try.
2. Chatpate paneer tikka : Smoked paneer tikka having mildly spiced marinade on it and simply melt in Mouth texture it was fabulous.
3. Mirza hasnu tikka : chicken tikka pieces having that perfect smokey tandoor flavor and slow cooked to perfection with red marinade preparation. It was super juicy and tender
4. patthar ke kebab: very unique presentation as the name suggests it was served on a piping hot stone slab. This is honestly the best appetizer in chicken we have had offlate. You shouldn't miss out on this one if you are here.
Later for the main course we went for lal rogani paneer which was this semi thick paneer gravy having lal rogan oil on top giving it very distinct flavor to it. In non veg we had murgh musallam which was very well prepared in my opinion unlike other places it had that premium touch to it as it was topped with ghee, dry fruits and edible gold on top. Fabulous gravies and it went just perfect with our assorted naan platter which they made on our request (it had lal naan, baquerkhani & zafrani taftoon).
For dessert the captain recommended us to try shufta which is basically mixed dryfruits toasted in Desi ghee and stewed with lemon scented honey. It was served with two scoops of mango ice cream and almond shortbread. Incredible creation by the chef. Would definitely visit here again.
Taftoon is truly about having that authentic flavors of Lucknow, awadh , kanpur , Bengal and many such northern parts of India. The hospitality is indeed amazing and it's one of a kind experience.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Pravin Master
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited a Taftoon at Powai that left me with an unforgettable culinary experience. The ambiance was warm and inviting, with comfortable seating arrangements. The service was excellent, with the staff being attentive and accommodating.

The star of the show was undoubtedly the food, which was simply spectacular. We started off with the kathal ki chapli, a delicious appetizer made from Jackfruit, which had a unique flavor and texture. The Mirza Hasnu Tikka was equally impressive, with tender chunks of chicken marinated in a flavorful blend of spices.

For the mains, we ordered the Lal Pagani Paneer and Murg Musallum, both of which were cooked to perfection. The paneer was creamy and flavorful, while the chicken was juicy and tender. The assorted bread basket was also a highlight, with the zafrani Taftoon, BaquerKhani, and lal Naan complementing the dishes perfectly.

To end our evening on a sweet note, we indulged in a delicious mango dessert, which was the perfect way to cap off an exceptional dining experience. Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a top-notch culinary experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Ambiance is absolutely perfect to dine in by soothing music, vibrant lights, small plots of trees, artistic walls. Comfortable seating arrangements accommodate large groups too.
To start a dinner with Kashmiri Kahawa tea had a cinnamon blast with spices. Pineapple Date Sharbat sweet and sour best to drink in between bites.
Dahi Butteyan de Kebab had a solid taste of hung curd, green chillies to get additional spice and mint chutney was classic paste to add.
Kathal Di Chapli - nicely roasted on pan with tomato slice on top. Jackfruit, garam masala and all spices just added a perfection to every bite.
Qasr e pakhtan - an extremely rich and classic curry in Awadhi style. Immediately melts Paneer with pumpkin and tomato gravy. Not on sweeter side but had a nice tangy taste to it.
Dal Makhani was creamy and infused with ghee went excellent with steam rice to get more flavor.
Must try Zafrani Taftoon which is their signature bread. Freshly baked with Saffron and light cardamom taste in it.
Baquerkhani which had a poppy seeds specially from region of Kashmir.
In desserts I had Pista Jam Pie with Rabdi. The best way to end this incredible meal.
Assisted by Mr Swakit had a great knowledge about dishes. Service was quick with pleasing hospitality.
@taftoonmumbai will definitely matches with the expectations. I believe this should be in my list of indulging in flavorful culinary experience.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant “Paddy” Demello
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Sagar Restro Bar, and overall, it turned out to be a pleasant and satisfying experience, deserving a solid four stars. The place has a welcoming vibe from the moment you enter — the lighting, seating arrangement, and overall ambience create a relaxed atmosphere that works well for both casual outings and small get-togethers. It strikes a balance between being lively and comfortable without feeling too loud or chaotic, which is something I really appreciated.

The service was quite good too. The staff was attentive, quick to take orders, and responsive throughout the visit. Even on a moderately busy day, they managed to serve everything within a reasonable time. Their politeness and readiness to help definitely added to the overall experience.

Coming to the food and drinks, Sagar Restro Bar offers a pretty decent variety. Most of the dishes we tried were flavourful and freshly prepared. The starters were particularly enjoyable — well-seasoned and cooked just right. The drinks were also nice, with good options at reasonable pricing compared to many other restro-bars. While the menu may not be extremely unique or experimental, it delivers well on the classics, and that’s more than enough for a comfortable night out.

There were, however, a few areas where the place could improve. Some dishes felt slightly inconsistent in taste, as if prepared differently on different days. Nothing too disappointing, but with a bit more consistency, the dining experience would become even better. Another small point is that while the ambience is good, certain corners of the seating area could use better lighting or layout adjustments to enhance comfort.

Despite these minor shortcomings, Sagar Restro Bar still stands out as a reliable and enjoyable place to unwind. It’s the kind of spot where you can expect good food, friendly service, and a relaxed environment without worrying about excessive noise or rushed service. I would definitely visit again and recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable restro-bar experience that’s worth the money.

featured_reviews.review_text: I went to Parabola with my family for lunch, this was our second time visiting the restaurant. The food was good, we really liked aloo gobhi adraki, kadhai chicken, tomato with basil oil soup, malabari prawns curry, chicken and pepper rasam soup and butter garlic prawns. featured_reviews.name: Vishal Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I  recently stayed at Hotel Rodas during a business trip, and it exceeded all my expectations as the perfect business hotel. From the moment I arrived, everything about this place radiated excellence and attention to detail.

The location is unbeatable—right in the heart of the Hiranandani ecosystem. It’s thoughtfully placed amidst a vibrant yet serene environment, with easy access to markets, restaurants, and relaxing evening spots. After long business meetings, taking a stroll through the nearby market was the perfect way to unwind. The area has a unique charm, blending convenience with calmness.

The team at the Parabola restaurant deserves special mention. Ashiyan, Komal, and Karan were incredible hosts, curating an exceptional dining experience that made my stay all the more enjoyable. They took the time to understand my preferences and presented the best options with impeccable hospitality. Their dedication to making guests feel cared for is unmatched.

The hotel itself is a reflection of high standards, from the well-appointed rooms to the seamless service. It’s clear that every detail has been thoughtfully designed to cater to business travelers. The ambiance strikes the right balance between professionalism and comfort, making it an ideal place to relax and focus.

Hotel Rodas is more than just a place to stay—it’s a complete experience. Whether you’re here for business or leisure, you’ll find everything you need and more. I will definitely be returning and highly recommend it to anyone visiting this area!

featured_reviews.name: Pankaja Date
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been visiting this place since it first opened. Back then, they used to offer a buffet, but now it’s à la carte. While the menu has changed slightly over the years, the food still tastes just as good. It’s a great spot for drinks and never too crowded. A perfect place to enjoy a quiet meal with your loved ones.

featured_reviews.name: Rakesh Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
We stayed at the hotel and decided to try the restaurant. I’m glad we did as we chose the Indian dishes and they were fabulous. Really well cooked Indian food. Just what we were looking for. We got the goan fish curry and tarka daal and they were beautiful. Had a couple of beers and some whiskey too. Really nice ambience in the hotel, with lots of light and open space and lovely decor.

The best bit is the service. Very friendly staff serving with a smile and professionalism making us feel welcomed and appreciated. Special shout out to Sagar and Megha on this evenings service. Even those who didn’t directly serve us were friendly and you could tell they were passionate about their work. Thank you!

featured_reviews.name: S N
featured_reviews.review_text:
A sizzler festival at the Parabola restaurant in Hotel Rodas must be a treat for food enthusiasts.

Sizzlers are known for their sizzling hot plates with a variety of delicious meats, vegetables, and sauces, creating a tantalizing experience for diners.

The sizzler festival is an excellent opportunity to indulge in a medley of flavors, and it's also a visually appealing experience with the sizzling plates arriving at your table, filling the air with delicious scents.

As festivals and menus can change, I would recommend checking with the Parabola restaurant or Hotel Rodas directly for the most up-to-date information on their sizzler festival schedule and the assortment of dishes they are offering. Enjoy your culinary adventure!

Parabola is serving five types of vegetarian/non vegetarian each to suit your taste buds.

featured_reviews.name: Tina Hanchate
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 star

Very disappointing experience with 1441 Pizzeria.

Ordered an 11-inch Margherita pizza and Chewy Dough Balls and both were extremely poor in quality.

The dough balls (₹299) were dry, cold, and completely hollow, with no cheese filling at all, despite the misleading menu images.

The Margherita pizza (₹449) base was stiff, rubbery, and painfully hard to chew. It honestly felt like biting into a brick. The pizza was improperly cut, the basil was burnt, and the food was not even warm, clearly not freshly made.

For a so-called premium brand, this quality is unacceptable.

Not recommended at all.

featured_reviews.name: Tina Hanchate
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing & unacceptable experience. I ordered an 11-inch Margherita pizza and Dough Balls, and the quality was shockingly poor. The dough balls (₹299) were dry, cold, and completely hollow, with no cheese filling at all, despite the menu images clearly suggesting otherwise. Totally misleading.

The pizza was worse in terms of texture. The base was extremely stiff, dry, and rubbery — chewing it was genuinely painful and felt like biting into a brick. It was improperly cut, not warm, and the basil and toppings were burnt/charred, indicating it was not freshly made.

I have attached a video showing just how hard and dry the pizza base was — it literally sounds solid when tapped. This is not what anyone expects from a so-called premium pizza brand.

To make matters worse, when I called the restaurant to report this, they put me on hold and disconnected the call without any response or follow-up, which was extremely unprofessional.

Based on this experience, I would strongly not recommend ordering from this outlet. Please check the attached video before deciding.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
1441 Pizzeria is one of my favourite joints to dine in for pizzas. I just loved their famous Wood fire pizzas. Since due to the pandemic, we are unable to visit the outlet so i gave it a chance to order it online from the newly opened outlet in Powai.

Tried the Tandoori Paneer pizza made in the thick crust, I loved their thin crust pizzas but the thick crust is good too. Loved the quality of bread plus the toppings were good. Loaded with paneer cubes, the pizza was soft and cheesy with a crisp base. I enjoyed the experience of ordering pizzas from 1441 pizzeria.

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Pitnaik
featured_reviews.review_text: Always been a fan of their pizzas. Ordered one up yesterday and it was lit. Came in warm, well packed and was intact, not messed up at all. Had generous amount of toppings too. Totally worth the price cap ! I ordered smoked chicken pizza along with 2 of their dips. The pesto dip was great, slight hint of pesto with a creamy taste. The cream cheese felt more like mayo dip. Pizza was just great, generous amount of toppings, great crust and perfect marinara sauce. Crust was crunchy on the edges and thin and soft un the center. Sauce had a slight tanginess with a strong basil flavor. Topping om the pizza consisted of olives, smoked chicken, mushroom and garlic. The garlic as a topping gave it an amazing kick. Totally worth the title of gourmet pizza !

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Bhosale
featured_reviews.review_text:
1441 Pizzeria has various outlets all over mumbai. Out of which I ordered from the one in powai.

Starting with the delivery I got my order on time. The pizza was perfectly packed and delivered to me at my door step. This shows how good their management and service is. The pizza was perfectly hot when delivered. The aroma itself was enough to give you goosebumps.

Talking about the taste then it was lip smacking. All of the flavours were perfectly blend in to it. The portion was enough for 2. The pizza was completely filled with cheese. The quality was great too.

It was a great time ordering from here.

*HIGHLY RECOMMENDED 💯*
